components.name: Navigation Tab Pill
components.description: Floating nav pill with Willow grey active background and dual-layer clip-path text transition.
components.css: .ds-nav-container { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: rgba(251,250,245,0.85); border: 1px solid rgba(212,212,216,0.7); border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; padding: 6px 15px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300; color: #7f7f80; border-radius: 9999px; transition: color 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { background: #c8d5bb; color: #27272a; font-weight: 400; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Tactile paper project media card with rounded 26px squircle corners, scale feedback, and bottom-left white glass badge.
components.html:
Apple • 2025
Designing new features to drive spatial interaction.
components.css: .ds-project-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; cursor: pointer; transform: scale(1); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-project-card:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-card-media { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 678/367; background: #e4e4e7; border-radius: 26px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(212,212,216,0.7); } .ds-card-badge { position: absolute; bottom: 12px; left: 12px; padding: 5px 14px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: #18181b; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); } .ds-card-sub { padding: 0 13px; font-size: 16px; color: #a1a1aa; }

narrative.overview: This visual system treats digital software as a warm, tactile material surface. Rather than stark dark modes or cold flat interfaces, the aesthetic is anchored in a soft paper finish (#fbfaf5 dough background with a 16px radial dot grid), muted organic Willow grey (#c8d5bb) accents, and precise Rust grey typography.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile Material Surface: Soft warm paper finishes (#fbfaf5) paired with ambient multi-layered paper card shadows.
Restrained Earth Palette: Willow grey (#c8d5bb) as the single primary accent, Rust grey (#47585c) for secondary hierarchy.
Dual-Layer Seamless Clipping: Active navigation pill overlays feature dual-layer clip-path text transitions.
Physical Motion Token Scale: Shared motion tokens (--duration-quick: 150ms, --duration-fast: 250ms, --ease-smooth-out: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)).

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The primary Willow grey accent (#c8d5bb) is reserved for active state highlights and interactive focus. Its rarity gives it visual authority.

rules.name: The Pressable Feedback Rule
rules.body: All interactive surfaces scale down to scale(0.97) on :active with a 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) transition, giving immediate physical feedback on tap/press.

dos: Do use var(--dough) (#fbfaf5) for page backgrounds to maintain the warm paper sanctuary feel.
Do gate all hover transitions behind [@media(hover:hover)] media queries.
Do use var(--ease-smooth-out) (cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)) for all surface transitions.
donts: Don't use pure dark #000000 or stark white #ffffff page backgrounds.
Don't animate non-GPU layout properties like width, top, or margin during state transitions.
Don't exceed 300ms duration for UI micro-interactions.
